_doc: The drowned lantern's surfaces (docs/kb/art/creatures/act3/drowned_lantern.md). glass: the globe and its skirt's eight lobes, crazed salt_glass (cavity in the craze lines), its emission mask the held light's glow on the glass near it (glimmer_held, steady); crust: the old brass cap gone bronze toward patina where the spawn's wet lacquer_black-to-abyss_navy crust leaves it bare, the hanging ring, and the one short open seam down into the glass lit spawn_wound with a slow weak-point pulse (ADR 0151); chain: wet iron links; cord: the frayed wick-cords and fine cords, sand_cloth darkened wet; light: the held beads, salt_glass lit glimmer_held, steady (color_script.md rule 1). Colours are palette.json swatches; write_materials.py on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader.
